name: Stack of Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes with Warm Syrup
whyItWorks: Light and airy pancakes made from refined flour deliver easy-to-digest carbohydrates with virtually zero rough insoluble fiber, making them an excellent gentle breakfast during low-residue recovery.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle with moderate warm pancake syrup. Skip margarine dollops or bacon sides if currently experiencing fat sensitivity.
